metadata.description: QuillShield smart contract security auditing skills for AI agents. Comprehensive coverage of OWASP Smart Contract Top 10 plus proxy/upgrade, signature replay, and token integration vulnerabilities. This library's mirror carries 5 plugins; the other 5 were merged into sources/symbiosis/.

plugins.name: behavioral-state-analysis
plugins.description: Multi-dimensional smart contract security auditing using Behavioral State Analysis (BSA). Combines behavioral intent extraction, parallel threat engines, adversarial simulation with PoC generation, and Bayesian confidence scoring.

plugins.name: reentrancy-pattern-analysis
plugins.description: Systematically detects all reentrancy variants — classic, cross-function, cross-contract, read-only, and ERC-777/ERC-1155 callback reentrancy.

plugins.name: proxy-upgrade-safety
plugins.description: Detects vulnerabilities in upgradeable proxy architectures — storage layout collisions, uninitialized implementations, function selector clashing, and upgrade path safety.

plugins.name: input-arithmetic-safety
plugins.description: Detects input validation failures and arithmetic vulnerabilities — precision loss, rounding exploitation, ERC4626 inflation attacks, unsafe casting, and unchecked block risks.

plugins.name: dos-griefing-analysis
plugins.description: Detects Denial of Service and griefing vulnerabilities — unbounded loops, gas limit exhaustion, external call failure DoS, 63/64 gas griefing, and storage bloat.

plugins.name: defender
plugins.description: Blue-team release-gate skill for deploy and upgrade readiness. Reviews CI/CD trust boundaries, deploy script safety, config drift, signer/admin operational security, and outputs an evidence-based release verdict.
